newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tommy Hilfiger downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tommy Hilfiger downgraded.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said on Tuesday it downgraded the shares of Tommy Hilfiger Corp to outperform from buy.
-- Analyst Allison Malkin said in a research note the downgrade was based on weaker-than expected retail trends.

-- "While the company's brand continues to outperform its competitors, its largest department store customers have told us that the men's collections area is not growing as fast as last year and one department store informed us that Father's Day did not meet expectations," she said.
-- Tommy Hilfiger shares were off 3-5/8 at 39-3/4.
